name: RORC Transatlantic Race 2027 — Virtual
description: Virtual edition of the 13th RORC Transatlantic Race: 2,995 nm from Marina Lanzarote to Antigua. Start 12:00 UTC Sun 10 Jan 2027 (real start time to be confirmed in the Notice of Race — the virtual start will match). Two marks only: how far south you dive for the trades before turning west is entirely up to you. Polar: 40 ft racer-cruiser at 90%; everyone sails the same numbers.
